Final Answer: 89 (patients with platelet lower than normal range, PLT < 150) vs 82 (patients with platelet higher than normal range, PLT > 400); the lower-than-normal group is larger — 7 more patients, i.e. about 1.085 times (≈8.5% more) the higher-than-normal group.
Evidence SQL: WITH t AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT < 150 THEN ID END) AS low_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN ID END) AS high_count FROM Laboratory) SELECT low_count, high_count, low_count - high_count AS diff, CAST(low_count AS REAL) / high_count AS ratio FROM t
